Hero_Desc_Laika: An accident at the power plant turned Laika, a Lightning Elemental, into a Noble Elemental. Despite her lack of experience, she has a lot of potential. Surprisingly, Laika maintains her word and feels accountable for her power, despite giving the impression that she is an elemental who does as she pleases.
Album_Hobby_Laika: Visiting cafes, plugging in her charger, and sleeping
Album_Laika1: Laika is a newly born high-ranking Elemental. Though technically an Elemental of electricity, she wants to be called an Elemental of lightning.
Album_Laika2: Laika loves consuming electricity. When asked why she ate more despite already having enough, she explained that there is always separate room for snacks.
Album_Laika3: Although now a high-ranking Elemental, Laika still prefers playing with her old lower wind Elemental friends. Other than needing a larger space because she has grown, nothing has changed.
Album_Laika4: Laika works far more efficiently at the power plant than she did as a wind Elemental, yet complains that this has reduced her working hours. She seems to be an unbelievable workaholic.
Album_Laika5: When bored, Laika used to create lightning and strike the ground. After hearing that the thunder frightened young Werebeasts to tears, she decided to stop doing it for fun.
Album_Laika6: I asked Laika what she thought of lightning rods. She explained that they only stop lightning from above, not electricity thrust in from the side. A lightning rod apparently will not stop Laika.
Album_Laika7: Whenever Laika visits the Order, electronic devices work without charging. I asked whether she could remain permanently, but she refused, saying she had heard the request hundreds of times.
LoveHero_Laika: There is nothing to fear when I am with you! Trust me!
LoveHeroCancel_Laika: R-Really? Are you sure you can manage alone without me?
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Hate1: She rarely reaches for it because its strange flavor is difficult to understand. She would rather have an ordinary sweet candy.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Hate2: Discovering nothing inside the fried coating, she became furious that its convincing appearance had deceived her.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like1: Laika said she liked its familiar flavor precisely because she had eaten it so often. Its excellent value pleased her too.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like2: Laika's eyes changed when she saw the expensive melon she rarely gets to eat. She devoured it at incredible speed and grinned as she requested another bowl.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like3: She seems completely enamored with the chewy rice cakes. She ordered about ten extra servings of them.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like4: Mid-meal, she suddenly ran outside to train by lifting logs. When she returned later, she said the food had been delicious.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like5: She loved the electrifying sensation of the tart flavor, then clarified that it was slightly different from an electric shock.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like6: She said the pretty pink songpyeon was best. The other colors had done well too, but pink still earned her highest praise.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like7: Declaring the almonds the tastiest part, she picked out only those. She looked surprised when I called it a new kind of picky eating.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like8: She liked that it tasted healthy and begged for several more, saying they would make good snacks.
Food_ChefNote_Laika_Like9: Despite rarely eating desserts, she praised these enthusiastically and demonstrated the unusual feat of eating three candies at once.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Laika: Which do you like better, thunder or lightning? I love both!
Gacha_Result_Line1_Laika: Want me to give you a shock?
Laika_Growth2: I am stronger now than I was yesterday.
Laika_Victory2: There is nothing high-voltage electricity cannot do!
Laika_Defeat1: Hmm? Was the voltage too low?
Laika_Affinity1_1: I am as fast as lightning!
Laika_Affinity1_2: Hi, Master! You will not get shocked if you shake my hand, so do not be scared~!
Laika_Affinity2: Monatium would be in serious trouble without me! Electricity bills would rise so much...!
Laika_Affinity1_3: You want to use me as a charger? Do not blame me if something short-circuits!
Laika_Affinity3: Bzzzt! I am practicing shooting electricity, so stay back!
Laika_Affinity4: The electricity from the things you use tastes delicious, Master! I will replace everything I eat, so relax!
Laika_Affinity5: You want to know who would win between me and a power plant? Why would we fight in the first place?!
Laika_Affinity6: Thank you for not getting upset even though I accidentally shocked you three times, Master!
Laika_Affinity7: Whenever I see you, Master, I feel a current pass through me. Are you a lightning Elemental too...?
Laika_Die1: Uagh, I need to recharge and come back!!
Laika_LevelUp: I became a smarter, stronger Elemental!
Laika_Equipment: It will become stronger if I run electricity through it, right?
Laika_HeroSkill: I can shock them with even more flair!
Laika_HeroUpgrade: Have I become an even higher-ranking lightning Elemental?
Laika_DeckSetting2: Shall I put some muscle into it?
Laika_Touch1: Next time, I will run electricity through my cheeks!
Laika_Touch1_1: Pulling at lightning speed, are you?
Laika_Touch2_1: Feels like electricity passed between us, does it not?
Laika_Touch2: Hee. I think this will cause static electricity.
Laika_Touch2_2: Haha, good. You are rather good at petting, are you not?
Laika_DutchRubEnd2: Ouch! What do you think you're doing?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Laika_Skin1: Laika takes the mound as the starting pitcher in Monatium's baseball tournament. She is thrilled at the thought of becoming the closer too, but is she left-handed or right-handed?
Laika_Growth1_Skin1: I am going to become the greatest pitcher!
Laika_Growth2_Skin1: It is not only speed that matters. Your build is important too!
Laika_LevelUp_Skin1: A top team will scout me!
Laika_Equipment_Skin1: Could I throw a ball like lightning?
Laika_HeroSkill_Skin1: I need to practice stealing bases more, even though I am a pitcher!
Laika_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I will become a first-rate pitcher!
Laika_Touch1_Skin1: Ah! Are you trying to ruin my condition?
Laika_Touch2_Skin1: Hehe, I will keep working hard.
Laika_Touch2_1_Skin1: Your hands are big. You should try baseball too.
Laika_Touch2_2_Skin1: I think I can do well in the next game too.
Laika_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Yeow!! I'm stuck with a terrible coach!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Laika_Skin2: Laika is on vacation. Lightning strikes the tranquil beach to punish any wicked forces that would ruin her holiday.
Laika_Growth1_Skin2: Rest is the nourishment of growth!
Laika_Growth2_Skin2: I will defeat anyone who interrupts our vacation!
Laika_LevelUp_Skin2: The calmest skies breed the strongest lightning!
Laika_Equipment_Skin2: Haha! I bet the breeze will flow right through!
Laika_HeroSkill_Skin2: A short rest has not dulled my instincts!
Laika_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Fully charged! Shall we go discharge it?
Laika_Touch1_2_Skin2: Come on, let me off today!
Laika_Touch2_1_Skin2: Hehe, it feels like a sea breeze!
Laika_Touch2_2_Skin2: As expected, this is when I feel best!
Laika_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Ugh! My head's no watermelon, okay?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Laika_Skin3: Laika has become a capable employee. She may seem somewhat rigid, but her broad and extensive experience makes her work exceptional.
Laika_Growth1_Skin3: Growth has no end, after all.
Laika_Growth2_Skin3: I need an even more electrifying idea!
Laika_LevelUp_Skin3: It feels like I have advanced another level.
Laika_Equipment_Skin3: Dressing properly is part of the job too!
Laika_HeroSkill_Skin3: I figured out how to work efficiently!
Laika_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: There are no limits for me!
Laika_Board_Skin3: I am going to play on a much bigger stage!
Laika_Touch1_1_Skin3: Was I a little too harsh...?
Laika_Touch1_2_Skin3: Are you taking revenge because I scolded you a little?!
Laika_Touch2_Skin3: It has been a while since anyone praised me~
Laika_Touch2_1_Skin3: I had only just steeled my resolve...
Laika_Touch2_2_Skin3: Taking a short break is nice too~
Laika_AsideGet: I will charge up as much electricity as I can, then release it all at once!!
Laika_AsideUpgrade: Haha, this is exciting! I can keep discharging electricity!
Laika_Ultimate1: Electricity tastes good, does it not?
Laika_BasicAttack1: I will slam it down on you!
Laika_Gacha2: Want me to give you a shock?
Laika_Gacha3: Which do you like better, thunder or lightning? I love both!
Laika_Line1: I will summon thunder and lightning everywhere!
Laika_Line2: I will protect the order of Monatium!
Laika_Line3: The power of lightning... It is incredibly cool, right?
LoveLetter_Laika:
Hello, Master! It is Laika!
Usually, whenever I want to see you, I run over like lightning, so writing a letter feels a little strange.
Anyway, I wanted to thank you for always working so hard for me and the other Apostles.
Whenever you need me, just say so. Understood? I will run to you like lightning... No, even faster than lightning!
See you next time, Master!
LoveCall_Laika:
Master! It is Laika!

My sudden call surprised you, right? There is something I want your advice about!
Can electricity pass through the heart? I am a lightning Elemental, but this feeling is new, so I am a little confused.

Why ask you instead of another high-ranking Elemental? Well... Normally it never happens, but whenever I think of you or meet you, my heart tingles as though electricity is running through it.
I thought perhaps you would know the answer~ so I called!

I rambled a little, did I not? When your work is finished, I will visit and explain the symptoms in detail!
Until then, take care, Master!
Affinity_Laika_EP01_001: Sylla asked whether I would like to live on Elemental Mountain. What should I do?
Affinity_Laika_EP01_002: Tell her firmly that you will do as you please and she should not interfere.
Affinity_Laika_EP01_004: Would it not be best for an Elemental to live on Elemental Mountain?
Affinity_Laika_EP01_005: But plenty of Elementals live elsewhere, do they not?
Affinity_Laika_EP01_006: Then tell Sylla she should come try living in Monatium too.
Affinity_Laika_EP01_007: That sounds good! Once Sylla tastes the convenience of the city, she will not be able to go back!
Affinity_Laika_EP02_001: What do you think about thunder and lightning, Master?
Affinity_Laika_EP02_002: I instinctively shrink back whenever lightning strikes.
Affinity_Laika_EP02_003: Hahaha, you are more of a coward than I expected, Master! Do not worry. I will protect you!
Affinity_Laika_EP02_004: I think it is cool. Lightning flashes, and the thunder sounds majestic.
Affinity_Laika_EP02_005: Which means... you think I, the lightning Elemental, am cool too?! Thank you!!
Affinity_Laika_EP02_006: They say it is safe inside a house during a thunderstorm. I am not afraid.
Affinity_Laika_EP02_007: You are not afraid of lightning?? Then I will have to show you what it can do!
Affinity_Laika_EP03_001: Can you shoot electricity from your body, Master?
Affinity_Laika_EP03_002: I cannot discharge electricity, but I can create static electricity.
Affinity_Laika_EP03_003: That is terrifying... I cannot believe I am not the only one who can do it...!
Affinity_Laika_EP03_004: Signals inside the human body are carried by weak electrical currents.
Affinity_Laika_EP03_005: W-what are you talking about all of a sudden? Do not say such difficult things!
Affinity_Laika_EP03_006: Normally, it is natural for no electricity to come out.
Affinity_Laika_EP03_007: Then are you saying it does come out sometimes?!
Affinity_Laika_EP04_001: A startled Elf used a stun gun on me once, but it did not hurt at all.
Affinity_Laika_EP04_002: The stun gun must have been the one that got shocked.
Affinity_Laika_EP04_003: My voltage is higher than its, so that makes sense!
Affinity_Laika_EP04_004: It would probably hurt more if they simply hit you with it.
Affinity_Laika_EP04_005: Do you want me to be hurt, Master? I am disappointed...!
Affinity_Laika_EP04_006: If it happens again, tell them to stop even if it does not hurt.
Affinity_Laika_EP04_007: Thank you for worrying about me, Master! If something like that happens again, I will give them a sharp warning!
Affinity_Laika_EP05_001: I used my electrical powers to fish, and Naia scolded me...
Affinity_Laika_EP05_002: Why would Naia scold you over something like that?
Affinity_Laika_EP05_003: Even I think I deserved to be scolded! Do not defend me too much!
Affinity_Laika_EP05_005: I caught Naia! That is why she scolded me! I should not do it again...
Affinity_Laika_EP05_006: Fishing must be done honestly with a fishing rod.
Affinity_Laika_EP05_007: Tch, if I have to do it in such a boring way, I would rather not fish at all!
Affinity_Laika_EP06_001: The Beastfolk say their fur stands on end when they come near me, so they do not want to approach.
Affinity_Laika_EP06_002: My hair is standing on end right now too. It has turned into a complete bird's nest.
Affinity_Laika_EP06_003: It was already a bird's nest before I arrived!!
Affinity_Laika_EP06_004: Try luring them with delicious snacks. They will not be able to resist coming over.
Affinity_Laika_EP06_005: Ugh, I want to eat them myself, but I suppose I will have to hold back and share.
Affinity_Laika_EP06_006: Try discharging your electricity. Then they may come closer.
Affinity_Laika_EP06_007: Would that not send me to the farm?!
Affinity_Laika_EP07_001: Which looks stronger, a power plant's electricity or mine?
Affinity_Laika_EP07_002: Obviously you are stronger, since you are the power plant Elemental.
Affinity_Laika_EP07_003: I am the lightning Elemental!! Who in the world is the power plant Elemental?!
Affinity_Laika_EP07_004: No matter how much electricity a power plant stores, it cannot beat lightning.
Affinity_Laika_EP07_005: Oh...! You say some pretty good things! I like it!
Affinity_Laika_EP07_006: Do not fight. You should get along.
Affinity_Laika_EP07_007: As fellow forms of electricity, it makes me competitive! I want to show that I am stronger!!
Affinity_Laika_EP08_001: How many volts do you like best, Master? For the record, the higher, the better for me!
Affinity_Laika_EP08_003: Right, right! It takes at least that much to count as electricity!
Affinity_Laika_EP08_005: Hmm, why are you grinning while saying that? What is so funny?!
Affinity_Laika_EP08_007: That is too modest! Too domestic!
Affinity_Laika_EP09_001: Ever since I became the lightning Elemental, I have eaten electricity with every meal. But it does not taste good...
Affinity_Laika_EP09_002: Buy some batteries at the convenience store and eat those.
Affinity_Laika_EP09_003: Ugh, I tried one before, and it was rather bitter. It felt unhealthy.
Affinity_Laika_EP09_004: How about trying electricity from wind power instead of thermal power?
Affinity_Laika_EP09_005: Hmm? Do the two taste different? I will test it!
Affinity_Laika_EP09_006: Being a picky eater is bad. You should become an Elemental who eats everything well!
Affinity_Laika_EP09_007: Hmph, what is wrong with eating only what I want?!
Affinity_Laika_EP10_001: Would you like an electric massage? It will feel incredibly refreshing~!
Affinity_Laika_EP10_002: Th-that is scary!! Do it without the electricity!
Affinity_Laika_EP10_003: Tch, if you had tried it just once, all that old fatigue would have vanished.
Affinity_Laika_EP10_004: I will accept it, but may I set a voltage limit?
Affinity_Laika_EP10_005: Then there is no satisfaction in doing it... Just take the high voltage and enjoy it!
Affinity_Laika_EP10_006: All right, I am ready! Shock me with all the electricity you want!
Affinity_Laika_EP10_007: I cannot believe you like it this much?! All right! Electric discharge!!
Affinity_Laika_EP11_001: I worked a part-time job at Monatium Hospital today!
Affinity_Laika_EP11_002: You did not electrically torture anyone, did you?
Affinity_Laika_EP11_003: What are you talking about?! What do you take me for, honestly!
Affinity_Laika_EP11_004: Treat me when you get paid.
Affinity_Laika_EP11_005: What? I did not think Master was secretly so petty... Should you not be the one treating me?
Affinity_Laika_EP11_006: You are working hard again today!
Affinity_Laika_EP11_007: Hehe, of course. I always work hard! Treating sick Elves made me feel good!
Affinity_Laika_EP12_001: Phew... It is especially dry today. Ugh...
Affinity_Laika_EP12_003: Oh... Really? Hehe. Everyone usually hates seeing me when it is dry, so hearing you say that makes me happy!
Affinity_Laika_EP12_005: Ah! Did you get a static shock? Ugh... I am sorry!
Affinity_Laika_EP12_006: Really? Where did I put the watering can?
Affinity_Laika_EP12_007: Ptooey! Do you think this will stop static electricity?! Ptooey! Stop spraying me~!
Affinity_Laika_EP13_001: Master! Ifrit and I created a finishing move together!
Affinity_Laika_EP13_003: What? What is ominous about it? What is with that look? You look like you suspect we caused an accident.
Affinity_Laika_EP13_005: Hehe. Right? When fire and electricity combine, they create an incredible sphere of light! That counts as a finishing move, right?
Affinity_Laika_EP13_006: For the finishing move, press down, down-right, right, then use a heavy attack!
Affinity_Laika_EP13_007: ...Sometimes you really know how to fluster an Elemental, Master. Impressive...?
Affinity_Laika_EP14_001: Master, did you know? You can cook food with electricity too!
Affinity_Laika_EP14_002: By supplying electricity to an electric range?
Affinity_Laika_EP14_003: What? Hmm... That is true too. Huh? Wait. That looks easier than cooking it directly myself.
Affinity_Laika_EP14_005: But controlling the power is still difficult, so I burn more than I cook. I will practice and show you later!
Affinity_Laika_EP14_006: Do you not simply burn everything?
Affinity_Laika_EP14_007: Tch. I am working on it, you know? If I cook one hundred things, I can salvage five now!
Affinity_Laika_EP15_001: Master, I thought the power was out at Kommy's house, so I supplied electricity, but she got angry. Why?
Affinity_Laika_EP15_002: You did not turn the lights on, did you?
Affinity_Laika_EP15_003: Huh? I did. How did you know? It was dark all day, so I lit the place brightly! ...Wait, was I not supposed to?
Affinity_Laika_EP15_005: Exactly. Phew... Ugh... I should apologize, right? Beastfolk are so difficult.
Affinity_Laika_EP15_006: It sounds like you were in the wrong.
Affinity_Laika_EP15_007: You are condemning me without even asking what happened? That is so mean!
Affinity_Laika_EP16_002: Try harder until you make a sound like thunder.
Affinity_Laika_EP16_003: Huh? H-how did you know?! I may be the lightning Elemental, but it bothered me that I could not make thunder. Hehe.
Affinity_Laika_EP16_005: What? Exercises? That is ridiculous. I am practicing extremely hard! Hiyaaaah! Come forth, thunder!
Affinity_Laika_EP16_006: Your flailing is so funny that I want to upload it to Elflix.
Affinity_Laika_EP16_007: Wow... How can you say something like that, Master...? That is so mean. I am disappointed.
Affinity_Laika_EP17_001: I have been so busy lately. Too many places are looking for me.
Affinity_Laika_EP17_003: What?! Someone like me is not merely a portable battery!
Affinity_Laika_EP17_004: You are racing around like lightning.
Affinity_Laika_EP17_005: Hehe, of course! I am the lightning Elemental. Then I will zip~ off to work again!
Affinity_Laika_EP17_007: Exactly, electricity is precious. So treat me well, unless you want a blackout.
Affinity_Laika_EP18_001: Someone asked how much maximum power I would have after evolving. I am already a high-ranking Elemental!
Affinity_Laika_EP18_003: That is true... but it still feels a little strange.
Affinity_Laika_EP18_005: That is true. Hmm~ But honestly, I am curious how much power I can produce too.
Affinity_Laika_EP18_006: Laika goes lai-lai when she cries.
Affinity_Laika_EP18_007: ...? What are you talking about? You are rather strange today, Master. Maybe an electric shock would clear your head...?
Affinity_Laika_EP19_001: I hear it is fashionable among lower Elementals to enter machines these days.
Affinity_Laika_EP19_002: It seems they all aspire to be Laika.
Affinity_Laika_EP19_003: Huh? W-well. Hehehe... No way. Hehe... But I hope that is true. Hehe, now I feel good.
Affinity_Laika_EP19_004: Are they fools? None of them are in their right mind!
Affinity_Laika_EP19_005: Well... They say they want to become electrical... no, lightning Elementals like me... But is that really so bad?!
Affinity_Laika_EP19_006: Is it all right for them to do that? It looks dangerous.
Affinity_Laika_EP19_007: That is why I am worried. Elven machines are all right, but also not entirely all right. Hmm~ Is there a good solution?
Affinity_Laika_EP20_001: Hmm. Master, the Banquet Hall table looks a little plain. Shall I make it look spectacular?
Affinity_Laika_EP20_002: Sounds good. Make it look impressive.
Affinity_Laika_EP20_003: Hehe. Trust me! I will make this place truly magnificent~!
Affinity_Laika_EP20_005: Why? Why not?! I will not burn the entire table! Trust me!
Affinity_Laika_EP20_006: If possible, do it on a jujube-wood table.
Affinity_Laika_EP20_007: Huh? Why? It absolutely has to be that one? Um... Why a jujube-wood table? What? A talisman?
